text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, is this
really my waiting room?"
choice_data_list: Your name was on the door, wasn't it?
Your name was on the door, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, of course... Then,
are you really sure I don't need to go
and greet the other runners...?!
choice_data_list: Some girls might do that, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like it's a strict rule,
and wouldn't most people actually choose not to...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's... right, isn't it...
I'm sorry, I just seem to be...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah——!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like they've started.
Ours is... the one after next, right?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...V-Very much.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I really wonder if someone like me even belongs here... I'm sorry, it's a bit late for me to be saying something like this, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy's hands are trembling slightly.
Considering her personality, it's completely understandable.
So—
choice_data_list: Could you lend me the "Heroic Tales"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "The Tale of Zenno Rob Roy's Heroism", is it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open the notebook and take out a pen.
The words to write were already decided.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: “Chapter One”...?
choice_data_list: Because this is finally where chapter one begins.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
That was quite a long prologue.
I hope the story turns out to be a masterpiece to match—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...That surprised me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Is that what you think? ...Why?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I might feel just a tiny bit
of pressure... or not.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, you're right. I'll... do my very best.
So that Chapter One doesn't end in disappointment.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That small back walking into the light
was still just a little stiff, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, her footsteps were steady and sure.
